title: Cancel a run input
description: Cancel a run that has not ended: Submitted, WaitingOnKey, WaitingForRoute, Running or WaitingOnDecision (a cancel of a run that waits on its serial key takes it out of the key's queue; a cancel of the run that holds the key lets the next take it once the runtime let the cancelled run go: its program in flight and its model call ended). The daemon stops the run in the runtime; a run that ended, was cancelled or failed to start is refused. In the same step the run's Open decision requests move to Withdrawn (the outcome's `affects` entry): no WithdrawDecision follows, and an answer to such a request is refused as DecisionWithdrawn. The daemon also writes the run event `runbook.cancel-requested` (an event of the daemon's own, see SubmitRun) just before the run is Cancelled; the language cannot write a RunEvent from this command (an outcome creates or moves rows of one entity and its `affects` entries move rows, they do not create them), so the event is stated here and read through the event views only.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.
